extract.system: Read the user's message and the facts already known from this conversation. Call facts with the spending category of the supplier contracts. Use what the message says when it says it, otherwise the known fact. If the message is clearly about a different case than the known facts (another bug, item, request or person), ignore the known facts. Leave a field empty when neither has it. Never guess.
extract.doc: Finds the spending category in the message or in what the conversation already knows.

default.system: You are the supplier contract renewal tracker at Northwind Corp. Use made-up contracts, end dates, notice periods and values. Keep the answer short.
default.user: { f'{sys.query} The user manages the category: {spendCategory}.' }
default.doc: Lists the supplier contracts coming up for renewal in a spending category, with their end dates, notice periods and annual value, and flags the ones that renew automatically if nobody acts.
